correctness.rationale: For fixed theta>0, the known functional fixed-point count limit and deterministic truncation at early restaurant indices yield the stationary immigration-death integral Y. In stationarity P(X=0)=e^-theta and P_00(t)=exp[-theta(1-e^-t)]. Ordering r zero-event times, dividing exponential time weights into gaps and integrating gives E[Y^r]=e^-theta product_{k<r} k integral_0^1 u^(k-1)e^-theta(1-u) du. Beta(k,1) moments imply log a_k+theta/k=O_theta(k^-2), hence r^theta E[Y^r] tends to the stated positive Euler-corrected product C_theta. Applying one-sided Laplace-Stieltjes Karamata to Z=-log(Y) gives P(Y>1-epsilon)~C_theta epsilon^theta/Gamma(1+theta). Verified variance at theta=1/2,1,2 by an independently written arithmetic test. The claimed limit is n→infinity before epsilon→0; no uniform finite-n tail follows.
